commitResults.messageBody: fix linking of MainApp.java from AB3 main repo to HitList repo

JsonAdaptedPerson does not handle empty strings in the json
file, leading to the file contents being thrown away.

Email and address fields are now optional, but current Jackson
version does not support jdk8 and above data types (i.e. Optional).

Creating a Person from the model requires both null-checks and empty
string checks.

This avoids storing those fields as Optional data types, but rather as
strings.
